title: RootNullInferredWrapper
$comment: Issue #267 at the fourth def kind: a root with no "type" of its own, whose Go type is inferred from the bound beside it and whose branches are what exclude a null. The inferred wrapper's rule is that a non-matching JSON type is stored raw and left unjudged -- which is right for a keyword that only applies to its own type, and wrong for a null every branch of the anyOf refuses. Reading the type list alone answered "null is fine" because there is no type list to read.
